title: Your control stays
text: Wraps a native input, textarea, or select in place without cloning or re-creating it.

title: Complete field chrome
text: Adds the label, required marker, help text, and validation message with correct ARIA wiring.

title: Localized messages
text: Maps the browser's validity state to consistent AbsoluteUI messages in every browser.

title: Form integration
text: Registers with Form, so wrapped native fields validate, submit, and reset with the rest.
